about: check_clarity.py --selftest: the regression set of docs/retro/2026-10-29_script_clarity/LINT_SPEC.md section 4 (R1-R5). Each case runs as its own script. 'lines' keys are sentence numbers (as check_rhythm.py numbers them) or a piece of the sentence's text; an expected flag is [code], [code, a piece of its span] or [code, span piece, message piece]; 'only' means no flag beyond has + may. When the panel or the owner finds a line the lint missed or flagged wrongly, add it here (R5) in the same commit as the fix.

sources.bigbend.md: the owner's model reel's opening (LINT_SPEC.md R3)
sources.rivals_dupes.json: a film list that names a rival twice ("chips", "chip"), as v4's first clarity.json did
